The rounded rectangle refraction-with-dispersion and default highlight shaders are extracted from backdrop/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/kyant/backdrop/internal/Shaders.kt. Kotlin string interpolation of the common SDF is expanded; the shader algorithms are unchanged.

Veil adapts these shaders to Android Views and samples only the user-selected panel wallpaper. It does not embed the Compose library or capture other apps. Native wrapper, wallpaper alignment, tint and lifecycle handling are Veil-specific.
